games.name: HOURS
games.desc:
Seize control of time itself to break through waves of foes in this singleplayer hack and slash with roguelite elements.

Features:
- 15 different characters called "Hosts" to play as, such as the Invader, the Witness and the Vestige.
- Mix and match them with 32 unique time powers called "Tempo". Stop time, go through time loops or predict the future. Time itself is yours to command.
- A variety of upgrades with powerful effects unique to each Host that promote various playstyles.
- Fight more than 30 challenging enemies and bosses that will test your skill to the max.
- All returns to nothing when you die. Your actions may be meaningless, but will you push forward and reach the end in spite of that?
- Face off against the most advanced AI on Roblox in endless mode.

Like this game? Share it, tell your friends, spread the word! Or buy Hands of Time, the game's premium gamepass!

games.name: CATASTROPHIA ☢️ Survive ☢️
games.desc:
☢️Rust LEGACY☢️ is not dead! Available on PC, phone, and CONSOLE with keyboard+mouse.
The game saves your base and backpack! You can come back and continue playing! Explore the map, hunt animals, craft items and fight⚔! Invite friends and build⚒ a base⛪ together.
(Unused structures decay.)
———————————————— 
New players have 3 lives:
* they have a green balloon in their hand
* items do not drop from them

Building tips:
* friends listed on the protection board can open doors and build in your house
* maximum of 3 protection signs
* poorly built walls can be removed with a repair hammer
* don’t forget a ceiling

Raiding tips:
* wooden doors need 2x dynamite, iron doors need 4x
* hitting doors with a rock is a waste of time

Cheaters will be banned!
